a.xlink:title: class Airline LAYOUT INFORMATION
class RegularFlight
Time time
Integer flightNumber

Airline 1 -- * RegularFlightA RegularFlight has An Airline. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Airline.An Airline has some RegularFlights. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a RegularFlight is created, its Airline must be assigned. When a RegularFlight is deleted, its Airline is not deleted and its list of RegularFlights is decreased. When an Airline is deleted, its RegularFlights are not deleted. They are assigned to another Airline.
